$comment: Written by `luaug new` so that opening this folder gives you completion, hover
documentation and strict analysis with nothing else to install. `luaug setup`
regenerates it, and .luaug/types/, for whatever engine version is pinned.
$comment.platform: LuauG is not the platform luau-lsp defaults to. `standard` is what keeps the
extension from downloading that platform's API dump, which would both disagree
with the definitions below and offer a surface this engine does not have.
$comment.fflags: The new type solver is on by default and is not synced from a remote endpoint,
so the editor's solver does not change under you between sessions.
$comment.docs: Hover documentation travels inside the definitions file as `---` comments, generated
from the same IDL text that produces the declarations. There is no separate
documentation JSON: that format is an LSP-only setting with no analyze flag, so
nothing in the engine's gate could prove a generated one was even shaped right.
